text: Squeezed light is a non-classical resource because it:
choices: Has zero photons and therefore no noise at all
Reduces the noise in one quadrature below the vacuum (shot-noise) level, at the cost of increased noise in the conjugate quadrature
Reduces the noise in BOTH quadratures simultaneously below the vacuum level
Amplifies both quadratures equally above the vacuum level
explanation: Squeezing redistributes vacuum noise: delta-X1 = e^(-r)/2 falls below the vacuum value 1/2 while delta-X2 = e^(+r)/2 rises, preserving the uncertainty product. Reducing both quadratures below vacuum (choice 2) would violate the uncertainty principle; choices 0 and 3 misdescribe squeezed vacuum, which contains photons and is not symmetric amplification.
